sources.title: Multimodal Large Models in Few-Shot Learning Scenarios
sources.snippet: This survey presents a comprehensive overview of recent advancements in the application of MLLMs to few-shot learning scenarios. We review representative models capable of few-shot adaptation, categorize common paradigms for few-shot multimodal transfer, and analyze the mechanisms that enable efficient knowledge transfer under limited supervision.

sources.title: Few-shot Adaptation of Multi-modal Foundation Models: A Survey
sources.snippet: Therefore, in this survey, we introduce and analyze the research advancements in few-shot adaptation methods for multi-modal models, summarizing commonly used datasets and experimental setups, and comparing the results of different methods.
